articles.summary: 8 years ago, I made an impulsive decision overnight. quit my cushy job at Goldman to join Sensorflow, a 2-month-old company then, as their founding engineer. It meant a 50% pay cut, long hours, and endless chaos. Looking back, I know it was the best decision I made and Just Words wouldnt be the same without that founding experience.
articles.title: The DNA of a founding team: Grit, chaos, and the right first hires
